svg.title: Evidence and Authority Posture Map – SkyHarbor Global
svg.desc: A proof posture visual for SkyHarbor Global showing loaded context, indexed evidence tiers, relationship confidence distribution, decision authority gates, finance authority gates, and explicit evidence gaps across the airline architecture graph.

Relationship strength tiers observed: tier1, tier2, tier3, directional, candidate
Claimable value not established where owner = owner_to_confirm_in_workshop
PANEL D — DOMAIN EVIDENCE COVERAGE BY AIRLINE ARCHITECTURE ZONE
Not yet evidenced in loaded graph
metric node present; system link unconfirmed
PANEL E — DECISION AND FINANCE AUTHORITY GATE MAP
Recommendation flow must clear each gate before advancing. Blocked gates halt promotion.
· Relationship strength = candidate only (no corroborating tier)
· Claimable value not established → report as unknown, not $0
· AI agent action without audited API gate clearance
· Finance authority not aligned to FY2027 budget ($2.35B envelope)
· Renderer rewrite attempted → rejected by validator
119 (claimable value: unknown / not established where owner unconfirmed)
Finance gate requires budget alignment before any recommendation referencing spend is promoted to advisory output.
PANEL G — EXPLICIT EVIDENCE GAPS (DO NOT PROMOTE UNTIL RESOLVED)
Digital channels (airline.com, mobile, airport kiosk) — no system nodes evidenced in loaded graph
Claimable value for 119 contracts — owner_to_confirm_in_workshop; value not established, not $0
Mainframe z/OS / CICS / DB2 topology — directional only; no confirmed system-level evidence rows
Airport turnaround metric (b32a70c387fed9de) — metric node present; system linkage unconfirmed
AI agent audit trail — candidate edges only; no confirmed audited-API gate evidence in loaded graph
Gaps must be resolved via workshop confirmation or additional CSV evidence before advisory promotion. Validator will reject unsupported claims.
